sourceReferences.title: Pearson Q-global: Entering SCL-90-R Scores
sourceReferences.use: 0–4 response coding and required-item gate; licensing remains unresolved.

sourceReferences.title: Pearson SCL-90-R Scales
sourceReferences.use: Cross-checks the nine symptom scales and GSI/PSDI/PST names; the official profile/report remains protected.

sourceReferences.title: Pearson SCL-90-R product information
sourceReferences.use: Cross-checks the stated age range, administration modes and separate norm populations; it does not supply a reusable Chinese norm.

sourceReferences.title: NIH GAP: Symptom Checklist-90-R
sourceReferences.use: 90 items, nine dimensions and three global indices; not an authorization.

sourceReferences.title: Scielo: Datos Normativos y Propiedades Psicométricas del SCL-90-R
sourceReferences.use: 0–4 formulas, 83 dimension items plus seven additional items; population norms cannot be reused without approval.

sourceReferences.title: Reliability and validity of a Japanese version of SCL-90-R
sourceReferences.use: Supports a Japanese translation/back-translation and validation review requirement; its sample and norms cannot be silently reused for this package.

sourceReferences.title: Study of the SCL-90 Scale and Changes in the Chinese Norms
sourceReferences.use: Shows that Chinese norm references and their application change across samples and periods; do not hard-code an undated Chinese norm.

sourceReferences.title: Undergraduate students’ norms for the Chinese version of SCL-90-R
sourceReferences.use: Provides a population-specific Chinese undergraduate norm study; it cannot be used as a general or clinical norm without matching the population.

sourceReferences.title: ITC Guidelines for Translating and Adapting Tests (Second Edition)
sourceReferences.use: Requires rights clearance before adaptation and documents translation, pilot data, validation, scoring/interpretation and user documentation gates for a trilingual version.

sourceReferences.title: Study of item text in the Chinese Symptom Checklist-90
sourceReferences.use: Documents that Chinese item wording differs across versions and proposes wording review; it is evidence for reconciliation, not permission to copy or a replacement for the authorized source.

sourceReferences.title: Psychometric properties of the symptom check list 90 for Chinese undergraduate students
sourceReferences.use: Provides reliability and validity evidence for a specific Chinese undergraduate population; it cannot be generalized to other populations without validation.

sourceReferences.title: Pearson Global Permission Granting
sourceReferences.use: Confirms that reproduction, adaptation or translation requires written rights clearance; authorization remains a publication blocker.

sourceReferences.title: NIMH Adult Outpatient Brief Suicide Safety Assessment Guide
sourceReferences.use: Requires trained follow-up after a positive suicide-risk screen, including current-thoughts assessment, safety planning, disposition and follow-up; this is an external clinical workflow requirement, not an SCL-90 diagnostic rule.

sourceReferences.title: NIMH Clinical Pathway for Suicide Risk Screening in Adult Primary Care
sourceReferences.use: Defines the operational sequence screening → safety assessment → course of action and supports requiring an owner, escalation path and response SLA before enabling high-risk alerts.
